title: Sum Two Numbers
problem_statement: Read two integers and print their sum. For example, if the numbers are 3 and 5, print 8.
input_format: Two lines. Each line contains one integer.
output_format: Print one integer: the sum of the two input integers. Do not print labels or extra text.

hints: The input gives you two values as text, one on each line. Python can convert each value to an integer.
Keep the two integers in separate variables. The plus operator adds integer values.
Use the plus operator on both variables, then print the resulting integer.
common_beginner_mistakes: Adding the input strings before converting them to integers, which can join the text instead of adding the values.
Reading both values from one line even though the input format puts them on separate lines.
Printing a label or explanation when the expected output is only the sum.
Using subtraction or multiplication instead of addition.
Adding only one of the input values or accidentally using the same variable twice.
Forgetting to print the calculated answer.
completion_criteria: Reads both input lines and treats their contents as integers.
Prints their sum, including when one or both values are negative or zero.
Passes the public samples and the separately maintained private tests.
